scope: Centered 3.5 by 3 mm receiver throats occupy the flank pockets. Flat mouths meet the split and bearing planes with 3 mm shoulders. The planar inner flares extend down into the PISCO and water-regulator cavities while following the passage roofs to retain the ledge supports. The pump east entry meets its existing aft airline opening.
physical_scope: Geometry readings establish fit, tool space and reversible service routes. Release force and repeated bending remain physical checks.

pisco_bearing_crown.scope: PISCO central 6 mm-wide upper bearing crown over its complete 3 mm axial bearing band. The local side windows retain this crown, the original fitted radius and the rear-wall bore.

wall_review.receiver_scope: The final report contains no new thin channel lips, cavity-intersection fins, PISCO ledge shelf or pump airline-entry skin. Existing tube spring sections, fitted cavities, flute fields and connector features retain their readings.
wall_review.scope_limit: This is a local review of receiver changes, not a claim that every pre-existing finding in either complete part has been resolved.
